Theme

Travel & transport

change trains verb

also transfer to another train, transfer (to another train)

modern

Traupman 215, 397

trāmina mūtāre

Examples

  • nec trāmen mūtāre opus est, nam rēctā Conimbricam it

    and we needn’t change trains, for it goes straight to Coimbracomposed

  • in aliud trāmen trānscendere

    to transfer to another trainTraupman 219

  • Mūtābis trāmina in statiōne Chicāgēnsī.

    You will change trains at the Chicago station.Traupman 211

See also change planes, train.

SourcesJohn C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 211, 215, 219.
